Full-size copies (900 px) are committed under artifacts/shots/tracks/bahrain/. Weather mapping: race(id,tod,weather) via shot.mjs --weather (storm included).

DAY · dry · orbit (6 frames)

Saturated flat royal-blue sky, no horizon haze. Olive/lime patches on dune bases (f50, f83) — see D1. f00: start gantry sits BEFORE the chequered line (D2). f67: cream wedge (stand end-wall) between orbit camera and car (D5).

DAY · overcast · orbit (6 frames)

Overcast lighting responds (flatter, greyer sand). Sky colour change mild.

DAY · fog · orbit (6 frames)

Fog is patchy low ground haze only: sky stays deep blue and dune ridges stay crisp at 300+ m — weak fog response (D3).

DAY · wet · orbit (6 frames)

Damp road reads darker; terrain mostly unchanged. Acceptable.

Rain streaks + grey sky; terrain darkens. After the day-wet-lighting merge this no longer reads as night.

DAY · storm · orbit (6 frames)

Storm: heavy grey sky, near-black wet sand, dark ridges. Reads as day. Stand end-wall still bright cream (f67).

DUSK · dry · orbit (6 frames)

Warm light; large sun bloom/lens-flare blow-out at f17 and f67 washes out the frame (D8).

DUSK · rain · orbit (6 frames)

Dusk rain: dim blue-grey, masts lit.

NIGHT · dry · orbit (6 frames)

Floodlit: masts light the track well, sand lit in pools, sky black. Pit-side roof left of f00 is a large unlit black slab. Green patch still visible at f50.

Wet reflections on road; masts + halos OK. f00 very dark left half.

NIGHT · storm · orbit (6 frames)

Storm at night: dark, rain visible, lamps remain readable.

Low sun: sun flare at f17/f67; shadows long; lamps still on.

DAY · dry · eye (6 frames)

Driver-eye: pit garages + lit signage read well. f67 shows a flat bright-green strip at the left horizon (D1). Asphalt looks grey-blue.

NIGHT · dry · eye (6 frames)

Driver-eye night: strong floodlight read, glowing masts, pit complex lit. Asphalt blue-tinted.

Ranked defects & suggested fixes

Nothing applied. Severity is my judgement of visual impact.

#1. High Olive/lime tint on every dune and ridge base

Where: js/track/core/geom.js:~271-275 (addMountain zoneAt: fr ≤ 0.34 → MAT.FOLIAGE); callers js/circuits/scenery/bahrain.js:91, :105, :194 (duneWedge), :820, :833, skirt js/track/scenery/nature.js:881

Mechanism / evidence: The lower third of every mountain() is emitted with the FOLIAGE (leaf) PBR layer; the baked pack multiplies albedo×tex×2, so the sand-coloured `forest` arg renders olive-green. Visible in orbit f50/f83 (all lighting) and as a lime strip on the horizon in eye f67. Hypothesis from reading source — the green is observed in frames; the MAT id is read from code, not probed (`__apex.matTex(0)` A/B not run).

Suggested fix (not applied): Engine (parent): let mountain()/addMountain take a `lowMat` (SAND/ROCK for desert theme). Circuit-only workaround impossible without an opt; or set forest colour darker to compensate (hack).

#2. Med Pit-straight props keyed to a stale SF constant (~50 m)

Where: js/circuits/scenery/bahrain.js:25 (SF = 0.7297, T1F = 0.8335) and comment :21 (`_sceneryShift` 0.27027) vs built def._sceneryShift = 0.26095

Mechanism / evidence: Measured: buildCenterline → def._sceneryShift = 0.2609494, so the true start line is at scenery 1−0.2609 = 0.7391; hard-coded SF is 0.0094 lap (≈50.6 m) earlier. Everything keyed SF+x (gantry :269, pit building :264, tribuna, tower :376, drag strip :991) sits ~50 m before where the start line is. Corroborated by f00 day/dusk/night: the start gantry (SF+0.005) is visible BEFORE the chequered line instead of 27 m after it. Likely, not proven — the pit/line relation was only checked in screenshots.

Suggested fix (not applied): Set SF = 1 − def._sceneryShift (or re-derive T1F from turns[0]) and re-tune gaps; or re-run tools/track/rotate-markings.cjs-style reseat. Re-capture f00 afterwards.

#3. Med Fog barely affects sky/horizon

Where: js/circuits/bahrain.js pal.fogDensity 0.0028 (def line ~41); engine fog consumer js/lighting/atmosphere.js

Mechanism / evidence: Day+fog frames keep the deep-blue zenith and crisp far dunes; only ground haze appears. Could be weather-blend or the per-circuit fogDensity being too thin for a 'fog' state. Cause not isolated — I did not read atmosphere.js line by line.

Suggested fix (not applied): Lighting-tuner pass: fog weather should override fogDensity floor and fade horizon colour toward fogColor; check circuit pal vs weather multiplier.

#4. Low University grandstand comments/placement disagree with lap position

Where: js/circuits/scenery/bahrain.js:478-486, :535 (comment 'T4 DRS straight'), :482 K(0.18)

Mechanism / evidence: Scenery-frame 0.18 + shift → racing ≈ 0.45, i.e. right at the T8 apex (turns[7]=0.4573), not T4 (racing 0.2503 ↔ scenery ≈ 0.98). Either the comment or the placement is wrong; the real stand location was not verified (no web fetch this session).

Suggested fix (not applied): Verify real location (bahrain.gp grandstand map, cited in :606-607) then re-key or fix comments. Brief table docs/tracks/bahrain.md §4 also quotes stale s values (Sakhir Tower 0.05 vs code SF+0.020).

#5. Low Orbit camera occluded by cream stand end-wall at racing 0.67

Where: js/circuits/scenery/bahrain.js:575-583 (grandstandEx 0.37/0.39/0.40/0.42, endWalls:true) ↔ racing ≈ 0.67

Mechanism / evidence: A large white wedge sits between the orbit camera and the car in every day/night/weather frame at f67. Prop is on the outside of a bend the survey orbit looks across. Not a ground defect; ?through camera flag exists. Also, in storm/rain/night the end-wall stays bright cream (no wet darkening).

Suggested fix (not applied): Survey-only: re-shoot with --through or a different az. Optional: darken end-wall material.

#6. Low Night: pit-side roof/apron reads as a black void

Where: js/circuits/scenery/bahrain.js:264 (building slab at gap 2, 16×14×80 right of line)

Mechanism / evidence: Orbit f00 night/rain: left half of the frame is an unlit flat slab (pit-building roof seen from above). No lamps/emissive trim on the roof; MAT only walls lit.

Suggested fix (not applied): Add a roof lip/lit strip or skylight emissive; low priority (visible only from above).

#7. Low Dusk/dawn sun bloom blows out frames

Where: js/lighting (presets) + pal.sunDir [0.5,0.14,0.4] (bahrain.js def)

Mechanism / evidence: f17 and f67 at dusk/dawn show a large orange flare covering a third of the frame. Probably bloom×low sun in orbit cam; not circuit-specific.

Suggested fix (not applied): lighting-tuner: cap sun bloom or exclude the flare when sun is within N° of camera axis.

#8. Info Baseline audit leftovers

Where: audit-circuit: coplanar 1 (baseline 1), ground buried 19 / unsupported 1 / flatCoplanar 1 (all within baseline); guard drops mountain=3

Mechanism / evidence: No regression; but 19 'buried' spots are accepted baseline. 3 mountain() calls suppressed at build (on-track guard) — which ones was not identified.

Suggested fix (not applied): Identify the 3 suppressed mountains via ctx.noteSuppressed log to confirm none is a ring-gap on the skyline.

#9. Info Duplicate code: main tribuna built twice

Where: js/circuits/scenery/bahrain.js:223-262 (sakhirTribuna) vs :275-314 (inline literal)

Mechanism / evidence: ~40 near-identical lines; the comment says the literal id is needed for landmark checks. Maintenance cost, props identical.

Suggested fix (not applied): Pass id as literal through the helper or allow a registry call; not urgent.
